in_hebrew.name: Neysa
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Nymph of the forest
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Neysa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Neysa was a nymph who lived in the forest and protected the wild animals. Her name derives from the Greek word 'neyo,' meaning 'to feed,' reflecting her role as a provider and protector.

in_greek.name: Neysa
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Nymph of the forest
in_greek.long_meaning: Neysa είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Greek mythology, Neysa was a nymph who lived in the forest and protected the wild animals. Her name derives from the Greek word 'neyo,' meaning 'to feed,' reflecting her role as a provider and protector.

in_latin.name: Neysa
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Nymph of the forest
